name: Ulvenwald
description: Vast ancient forest covering much of Kessig on Innistrad, also called the Misty Wood or Impossible Wood, haunted by werewolves and spirits.

timeline.summary: Humans move into the area, name it Kessig, fell trees, plant crops and pray to angels against forest evils.
timeline.quote: But then humans moved into the area and named it Kessig, felling trees and planting crops and praying to the angels to keep the evils of the forest at bay.

citation.text: "Kessig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's return strengthens wards and blessings in Kessig but does not eliminate the Ulvenwald's horrors.
timeline.quote: Avacyn's return strengthened the wards and blessings, but it did not eliminate the horrors of the Ulvenwald.

citation.text: "Kessig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halana and Alena suspect lycanthropes have grown brazen and are working their way to the town after having killed several in the Ulvenwald.
timeline.quote: they would not let its dark horrors leak out to harm the innocent.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Halana and Alena recall rescuing the Palters in the Ulvenwald and receiving a protective token from the cathar.
timeline.quote: Hal and Alena had found the cathar and his wife themselves no more than a week ago

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Armed with silver, they track Cathar Palter's trail, finding boot prints that become paw prints and a split trail at a crossroads.
timeline.quote: the next they were tracking the paw prints of a beast

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Elsa announces the bell-ringer Orwell is dead, and the trackers find the bodies of Orwell, Lady Evelin and Elder Somlon arranged in the woods.
timeline.quote: the same that had been done to the bell-ringer had been done to the ward-maker, Lady Evelin

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: They realize the lace belongs to Elder Somlon and that the lycanthrope may be Mrs. Palter.
timeline.quote: Then what of Mrs. Palter?

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Halana and Alena find Mrs. Palter chanting Ormendahl over her husband on a makeshift altar and tackle her.
timeline.quote: This woman was in contract with a horror.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Alena explains the cathar hid his wife's killings; he begs for her life and blames himself for the mausoleum.
timeline.quote: Three bodies, Mr. Palter. She killed three innocents.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Palter breaks free and stabs her husband in the chest, killing him.
timeline.quote: in one motion tackled and stabbed her husband through the chest.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Demonically empowered, Mrs. Palter throws Halana and Alena aside and beats them.
timeline.quote: called upon the enormous amount of demonic power she had summoned and threw them off her.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: A lycanthrope strikes Mrs. Palter down, and Halana and Alena stab her dead.
timeline.quote: Together they plunged their blades into Mrs. Palter's raging, bloody form.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: A pack of werewolves surrounds them, but the leader changes into a human woman and sends the pack away.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the beast was a human woman

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: The woman, who says she tracked Mrs. Palter, warns them to stop killing her pack and leave the Ulvenwald, since something worse is coming.
timeline.quote: I have seen enough, and so have you, to know that whatever is out there is worse than werewolves.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: The woman resumes wolf form and leaves; Arlinn Kord reflects she cannot have friends.
timeline.quote: in this life, Arlinn could not have friends.

citation.text: "Under the Silver Moon" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Klaus, a Falkenrath vampire, runs through the Ulvenwald from a pack of hunters, grinning.
timeline.quote: His feet slap against the brush; blood drips from his slick chin onto the reddening leaves of the Ulvenwald

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At dusk Klaus drops his glamour and turns into a monstrous form to terrify the hunters.
timeline.quote: Already he can feel it, his body straining beneath the glamour, his teeth growing longer and sharper.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The hunters shift into towering werewolves in the moonlight.
timeline.quote: their bodies exploding from their fleshy constraints into their real forms: towering beasts

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The werewolf leader tells Klaus the rhyme only applies to humans.
timeline.quote: only applies to humans

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The werewolves kill Klaus as he leaps from the branch.
timeline.quote: Jaws crush his chest.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Leinore pretends to sleep and then follows Sinnia into the forest at night.
timeline.quote: Leinore followed Sinnia into the night.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Leinore sees Sinnia drag an unconscious man to a giant egg that opens and swallows him, and notices a woman watching from the shadows.
timeline.quote: To Leinore's horror, she watched her sister push the unconscious man into it.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda grabs Leinore and aims her staff at Sinnia, but Leinore bites her hand and ruins the shot.
timeline.quote: Without thinking, Leinore bit down on Katilda's hand.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda reveals that the woman is Saryth, whose power lies in the mask, and that Sinnia is consumed by it.
timeline.quote: "Saryth isn't the one wearing the mask," Katilda said, picking up her staff.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
timeline.quote: "It is time!" Saryth screamed.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda urges Leinore to destroy Sinnia, but Leinore insists on trying to take the mask off and Katilda agrees to distract Saryth.
timeline.quote: "Don't you dare touch my sister. I'll get the mask off her."

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda fights Saryth with shale and a razor wind of leaves, and Saryth falls into the chasm and is swallowed.
timeline.quote: And in an instant, Saryth was gone—swallowed by the chasm.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sinnia whispers for help and Leinore tears the fused mask off her face as the Coiled One bends to swallow them.
timeline.quote: Without thinking she started to pull as hard as she could.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: With the mask gone the Coiled One bellows and retreats into the earth, pulling the eggs down with it.
timeline.quote: With one last hiss, the Coiled One dragged its body to the depths of the earth

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Halana comments that the Ulvenwald agrees a stone creature cannot fly.
timeline.quote: A creature of stone was never meant to fly. And I see the Ulvenwald agrees with me.

citation.text: Plummet (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bruno dies after mistaking a werewolf for a wolf.
timeline.quote: Oh, thank the angels. It's not a werewolf, just a regular wo

citation.text: Snarling Wolf (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Old powers stir in the Ulvenwald as day and night twist.
timeline.quote: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.

citation.text: Dormant Grove (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A long-slumbering force rises to protect its home, far from the wedding.
timeline.quote: a long-slumbering force arose to protect its home.

citation.text: Gnarled Grovestrider (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Seven allows Wrenn to merge with it, disappearing into its trunk.
timeline.quote: It allowed Wrenn to merge with it

citation.text: "Seven", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Werewolves of the Vildin Howlpack hunt travelers, chasing them in circles through the mist.
timeline.quote: They often hunt by toying with their prey
